title: UCell: a small recursive transformer for generalizable cell segmentation
description:
UCell is a ~15M-parameter recursive transformer for cell instance segmentation. The same two-block transformer is applied repeatedly to refine an internal representation, so depth comes from recursion rather than from parameters, which keeps the model small while generalizing across imaging modalities.

This record archives the source code. Preprint: https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2604.00243
